meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把 Matrix 聊天频道接入你的系统，并完成配置和测试等步骤。
howto.when: 当你说出添加 Matrix 或要求接入 Matrix 聊天频道时，此技能会触发。

say.text: 请给我的系统添加一个 Matrix 频道。
say.note: Claude 会按流程完成添加并运行测试。

say.text: 我想把 Matrix 聊天接入进来，帮我配置一下。
say.note: 它会询问服务器地址和机器人账号等必要信息。

say.text: 帮我配置 Matrix 频道，然后运行一次测试。
say.note: 技能会执行构建和注册测试来验证配置。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can add a Matrix chat channel to your system and handle configuration and testing steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Matrix or to integrate a Matrix chat channel.

say_en.text: Please add a Matrix channel to my system.
say_en.note: It will complete the integration steps and run tests.

say_en.text: I want to connect Matrix chat. Configure it for me.
say_en.note: Asks for the server URL and bot account credentials.

say_en.text: Set up a Matrix channel and run a test afterwards.
say_en.note: Runs the build and registration test to verify.
